newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Rotterdam bunkers fall $3 as barges slide.
newsitem.headline: Rotterdam bunkers fall $3 as barges slide.

text.p: Rotterdam fuel oil bunkers lost about $3 on Tuesday as barges slid, while prices in the rest of Europe were little changed, dealers said.
Rotterdam bunkers were quoted about $3 a tonne down at $83/$84 fob as barges were offered as low as $83 ex wharf late.
Some larger enquiries emerged, including one for 7,000 tonnes, but total ARA demand barely reached 15,000 tonnes.
Mediterranean prices were mixed, with little clear direction from underlying cargo prices.
Italian prices firmed, Spanish bunkers were unchanged, French prices softened.
A number of ports reported good business, some of it, they said, because of the Greek Easter this weekend.
"There's a lot of Greeks with ships obviously, and it seems they want cover over the weekend," one Mediterranean supplier said.
Further east, the pre-weekend rush took place yesterday. The markets were becalmed by Wednesday.
